subject: Phase-out notice & transition schedule — MSA + Order Form alignment
messages:
From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finworks.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Draft MSA + Order Form (phase-out notice)

Rishi —

Thanks for the redline thread. We reviewed the MSA and the Order Form and have two main items that are blocking procurement signoff on our side: the auto-renew mechanics and the termination-for-convenience notice window.

Quick summary of FinWorks asks: 
- 90-day notice for convenience termination (we want symmetry with our vendor matrix).
- If there is an auto-renew, allow a 60-day notification window for cancellation prior to renewal date.
- A phased transition assistance clause for customers in scope for up to 120 days after termination (to cover model exports, data handoff, and parallel run).

I've attached a highlighted MSA (FW-Redline_MSA_v3.docx) and the OrderForm_Summary. Elena (our GC) is on the thread for legal specifics.

Can Rishi / Redwood confirm where you can be flexible? If we need legal to do a quick call, please propose times — we are on ET.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Rajesh Patel
Head of Procurement, FinWorks Inc.
rajesh.patel@finworks.com
+1 415 555 0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 16:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form (phase-out notice)

Rajesh —

Appreciate the summary and the marked-up MSA. Quick response from the business side: Redwood is generally open to clarifying notice windows but we need to balance operational constraints for customers that rely on reserved capacity. A couple of immediate constraints:

1) Auto-renew cancellation window: we can accept a 60-day cancellation notice prior to the renewal effective date for the Order Form (good). However, for customers on Dedicated or Private deployments that reserve capacity, we need an earlier planning window for capacity reallocation — we usually ask for 90 days for changes that impact reserved pools. Can we mark behavior-based exceptions in the Order Form (i.e., 60 days standard, 90 days if Dedicated capacity is impacted)?

2) Termination for convenience: we are hesitant on a 90-day mandatory notice that is asymmetric to Redwood's termination rights. We can offer a 60-day mutual convenience notice as a compromise. Alternatively, we can provide a 90-day notice but include a phased service-credit schedule to protect Redwood from immediate revenue cliff.

3) Transition assistance: we agree to provide transition support up to 120 days; we would want to scope it (hours, deliverables, and additional fees if more than baseline). The attached OrderForm_Summary can include the SLA for handoff.

Laura and Neha are copied for legal language. Aditya — can you attach a proposed capacity exception clause for Dedicated?

I'll coordinate a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps — propose 11am ET.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finworks.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:43:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form (phase-out notice)

Rajesh / Rishi —

Thanks for the clear asks. From a legal perspective I've reviewed FW-Redline_MSA_v3.docx and propose these concrete edits (high level):

- Notice windows: Replace the currently proposed 90-day unilateral windows with a mutual approach. Suggest language: "Either party may terminate for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice; for termination of a Dedicated/Reserved Capacity Order Form, Customer shall provide ninety (90) days' prior written notice to allow for capacity reallocation."

- Auto-renew: Add a clause to the Order Form: "Unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current Term, the Order Form shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year periods. For Order Forms that include Dedicated or Private deployments, the non-renewal window shall be ninety (90) days."

- Transition assistance: Add a defined "Transition Assistance" SOW reference in Schedule X: 120 days of transition support included for subscriptions up to $X, with a defined hourly rate for extra work and a requirement that customer provide clear acceptance criteria for exported data. Also include a data retention/secure transfer paragraph.

- Service credits / ramp-down: If customer elects termination with less than the Dedicated-notice (i.e., under 90 days), Redwood may apply a pro-rated termination charge equal to the unused portion of the committed Reserved Capacity for the remainder of the then-current term unless otherwise agreed in writing.

I'll attach a tracked-changes MSA with these edits if you want to circulate back.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 646 555 0126

Attachment: Proposed_MSA_Notice_Clause_excerpt.txt

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finworks.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@finworks.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form (phase-out notice)

Laura —

Thanks for taking a pass. The proposed mutual 60/90 approach is acceptable to FinWorks provided the following are added: 

- A clear definition that "Dedicated/Reserved Capacity" refers to Order Forms that include any committed GPU pool or fixed-instance allocation for the customer.
- A hard cap on the pro-rated termination charge (e.g., not to exceed the lesser of 3 months fees or the remaining term).

We can accept the 60-day mutual convenience notice for standard subscriptions and 90 days for Dedicated, with the capped ramp-down charge. Elena has one minor edit to the auto-renew sentence and will send a tracked change.

If Redwood can accept those two bullets, we are comfortable moving to signature and will route to procurement. We can do electronic signature via the DocuSign link you provide.

Next steps: Laura/Redwood to confirm language, Rishi to confirm DocuSign package, FinWorks procurement will sign upon finalization.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Rajesh Patel
Head of Procurement, FinWorks Inc.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finworks.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form (phase-out notice)

Team —

Summary and agreed items (for record):
1) Mutual termination-for-convenience: 60 days for standard subscriptions; 90 days where Order Form includes Dedicated/Reserved Capacity (we will include a definition).
2) Auto-renew: 60-day non-renewal notice standard; 90-day for Dedicated/Private deployments.
3) Pro-rated termination charge: capped at the lesser of three (3) months of recurring fees or the remaining paid term for Dedicated capacity to protect reserved-pool economics.
4) Transition Assistance: 120 days included per SOW with defined hourly overage rates; customer to provide acceptance criteria for exports.
5) Define "Dedicated/Reserved Capacity" in Order Form and include cross-reference to Schedule X (Transition Assistance).

Action items:
- Laura to circulate final tracked MSA/Order Form with the agreed clauses by EOD Friday (attachment: FW-Redline_MSA_v3.docx will be updated).
- Aditya to prepare a short capacity-exception blurb for insertion into the Order Form.
- Rishi to assemble DocuSign package once final documents come back from Laura. DocuSign link placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/fw-signing-2027
- Rajesh/FinWorks to confirm routing and signature ETA (Rajesh indicated procurement will sign once language is final).

I'll leave Laura to send the final tracked changes. Thanks everyone — good progress.
